description: Summarize overall vault health and inventory: total Markdown notes, YAML frontmatter coverage, unique speaker list, total and unresolved [[wiki-link]] counts, and open vs completed action-item totals. Use this first to orient on a vault before running targeted okf_search_meetings or okf_list_action_items queries. Read-only and 100% offline. Takes no parameters and returns a single JSON summary object (zeros when the vault directory is empty).
name: okf_vault_stats
title: Audit Local Vault Health & Statistics
